blurb:
This magical 4-mile sunset paddle through Black Canyon Narrows delivers nonstop wow—from towering canyon views and wildlife sightings to exclusive access to Emerald, Echo, and Lover’s Caves, all glowing in golden hour light. As twilight falls, your kayak lights up for a surreal, otherworldly journey back under a vibrant desert sky.

Along the way, your guide captures hundreds of photos and videos, so you can stay in the moment while leaving with incredible, golden-hour memories.

With all gear, snacks, juice, and water included—plus top-rated guides and a relaxed, small-group setting—this is the sunset experience everyone wishes they had booked.
